description_en: Queries the jobs of the recycle bin
description_zh: 查询回收站中的一个或多个任务信息
kebab_example: aliyun nas list-recycle-bin-jobs --file-system-id 1ca4040000 --job-id rb-150000ed-r-162500002441 --page-size 10 --page-number 1 --status All --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListRecycleBinJobs

parameters.description_en: The ID of the file system.
parameters.help_en: The ID of the file system
parameters.name: file_system_id

parameters.description_en:
The number of entries per page.

Valid values: 1 to 100.

Default value: 10.
parameters.description_zh:

取值范围：1~100

parameters.name: page_number

parameters.description_en:
The job status. Valid values:

*   Running: The job is running.
*   Defragmenting: The job is defragmenting data.
*   PartialSuccess: The job is partially completed.
*   Success: The job is completed.
*   Fail: The job failed.
*   Cancelled: The job is canceled.
*   all (default)
parameters.description_zh:
任务状态。取值：

- Running：运行中
- Defragmenting：数据整理中
- PartialSuccess：部分运行成功
- Success：运行成功
- Fail：运行失败
- Cancelled：已取消
- All（默认值）：全部
